stories.headline: CLARITY Act stablecoin debate: Dimon vs. Coinbase over rewards/yield provisions
stories.relevance: US stablecoin framework legislation remains contested; final text blocks yield-bearing stablecoins that resemble bank deposits but allows bona fide payment flows
stories.data_connection: Regulatory uncertainty may be suppressing volume growth on Ethereum/Base vs. less-regulated chains; could affect q1_volume_transfers trends if institutional flows are paused pending legislation

stories.headline: USDC outpaces USDT in institutional adoption: 86% of surveyed firms use USDC vs 68% USDT in 2026
stories.relevance: USDC gaining ground in regulated payment flows and DeFi while USDT retains dominance in P2P and exchange settlement; total stablecoin tx volume hit $33T in 2025
stories.data_connection: Explains q1_summary token-level split between USDC and USDT, and q2_non_defi breakdown showing shift in non-DeFi/P2P usage patterns

stories.headline: Tron and Ethereum compete for top stablecoin supply spot; Tron leads P2P flows in 2026 with $6.1B+
stories.relevance: Tron processed $2.0T in Q1 USDT volume (vs Ethereum $2.2T); Tron holds ~$91B stablecoin market cap. Ethereum leads supply at $175.8B
stories.data_connection: Directly explains q3_chain_dominance metrics showing Ethereum/Tron split; also relevant to q4_p2p_sizing given Tron's dominance in P2P payment flows

stories.headline: Visa expands USDC settlement in the US with 7-day availability and 2026 global expansion plan
stories.relevance: Visa integrating USDC for 24/7 settlement including weekends reduces friction for institutional and retail payments
stories.data_connection: Could drive q5_new_wallets growth on Ethereum/Base as Visa-connected merchants onboard; also relevant to q2_usage_heatmap weekend activity patterns

stories.headline: Stablecoins account for 82% of crypto payment gateway transactions in 2026; 25M+ merchants now accept crypto
stories.relevance: Merchant adoption growing rapidly; USDT holds 33% of merchant crypto payment volume. Coinbase Commerce exited non-US/Singapore markets March 31, 2026
stories.data_connection: Coinbase Commerce exit could reduce Base chain activity in certain regions; merchant growth explains sustained transfer volumes in q1_volume_transfers and q2_non_defi breakdown
